prompts.mochi:
Create a production-ready transparent sprite animation atlas for a cozy mobile companion game. Reference image: the supplied Samo sheet, use ONLY its soft outlined pixel-illustration character style, round cute proportions and emotional expressiveness; create a NEW cream-and-apricot CAT named Mochi with short triangular cat ears, whiskers, a curled cat tail, chubby body, dark round eyes. Clearly feline, not a dog. No clothing. Raster pixel art with clean softly colored edges, warm cream fur with apricot forehead/ear patches and a white belly, little pink nose. NOT a 3D render.
OUTPUT: exactly 4 columns by 6 rows of equally sized SQUARE sprite cells, a 2:3 portrait canvas (1024x1536 or equivalent). Transparent background throughout. No grid, no words, labels, numbers, props, colored background, checkerboard, shadows or floor. Exactly 24 full-body CAT sprites. Each sprite centered horizontally, consistent scale, generously separated, feet on the same baseline relative to its cell. Nothing crosses a cell boundary.
Rows top to bottom:
1: neutral idle, four small distinct poses: eyes open, blinking eyes shut, head tilt, relaxed open eyes.
2: happy, four cheerful distinct frames: smile, eyes squeezed happy, tiny bounce, smiling with tail curled.
3: sleepy, four resting curled-up poses with eyes shut, slow breathing slight body changes.
4: playful/excited, four lively frames: paw up wave, both paws up, small hop, landing happy.
5: hungry/tired, four gentle low-energy poses: ears droop, looking down, small sigh, upward hopeful glance. No distress or tears.
6: sad/needs company, four subtle poses: soft sad eyebrows, downward glance, seated droopy posture, looking hopefully toward viewer.
Identity, colors, face and proportions must stay identical across every cell. These frames will be animated with CSS discrete sprite stepping, so precise 4x6 placement and transparent alpha are critical.
prompts.nori:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production mobile game sprite animation atlas. Create a NEW charcoal-black CAT named Nori, with a white chin, little white paws, lavender-gray fur highlights, triangular cat ears, whiskers, curved cat tail and tiny pink nose. Clearly a CAT, not a dog. Match ONLY the reference sheets' cute softly outlined pixel-illustration style, round proportions and expressive poses. The cream cat reference shows the EXACT requested grid layout. Keep this NEW character's identity identical across all frames. No clothing.
EXACT OUTPUT: transparent RGBA atlas, 4 equal columns × 6 equal rows, 24 FULL-BODY sprites, portrait 1024×1536 canvas, each cell 256×256. Every sprite centered inside its square cell, consistent scale and baseline, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Generous cell separation. Transparent empty space, NO backdrop, ground, shadows, props, checkerboard, labels, borders, grids or words.
Rows, top to bottom, 4 distinct frames in each:
1 IDLE: alert open eyes; blink eyes shut; small head tilt; relaxed open eyes.
2 HAPPY: smile; eyes closed happy; small cheerful bounce; happy tail wag.
3 SLEEPY: curled up eyes shut; slight inhale; exhale; relaxed asleep. 
4 PLAYFUL: one paw wave; both paws raised; small hop; landing happy.
5 HUNGRY/TIRED: drooping ears; looking down; small sigh; hopeful upward glance. Gentle and cute, no tears.
6 SAD/NEEDS COMPANY: sad eyebrows; downcast glance; seated low-energy posture; hopeful glance at viewer.
NOT a 3D render, photorealism, generic icons or emoji. Precise sprite placement is critical. Each frame must show a distinct expression or pose to animate visibly.
